'''Jeet Travis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. He drank [[Vaschean rye/Legends|Vaschean rye]], and was once conned out of a bottle of it by [[Sam Heggs]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].
